The eLife site returned HTTP 406 to an automated request and PMC blocked its PDF endpoint (HTTP 403 on https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8550750/pdf/), so the PDF was fetched from the eLife CDN at https://cdn.elifesciences.org/articles/71774/elife-71774-v2.pdf, 687843 bytes, 34 pages -- version 2, the version of record. Europe PMC confirms PMCID PMC8550750, isOpenAccess Y, licence 'cc by', and the NCBI OA service returns license="CC BY" for the same record. DATA: hosted datasets default to a Creative Commons Zero public domain dedication, which the paper describes in three different ways (dedication, licensing, data use agreement); CC0 is a waiver and the precise body wording is what the card carries. Data collected under the General Data Protection Regulation cannot be hosted. md_quality is rough: body prose is single-column and reads cleanly, but Table 1 (datasets per modality) was serialised with its labels and counts in separate line runs and the header appearing after the first data row, so the modality-count pairing on the card was reconstructed positionally; the counts in that table sum to 1124 against 604 total datasets, and the paper never states that a dataset may be counted under several modalities. Figures 1 to 4 are image-only and lost apart from captions and, for Figure 1, its step labels which survived as running text. Funding, ORCID and data-availability tables are scrambled into label and value runs.
